summary: Cloud accounting platform for small businesses covering invoicing, bank reconciliation, payroll and reporting.
access_note: Free developer account and Starter tier app; Demo company for testing. Custom Connections (client credentials) cost a monthly fee on the Xero organisation.
blocker_note: Starter tier is limited to 5 connections and each organisation can connect only five uncertified apps; scaling needs higher tier and App Store certification.

evidence.quote: Xero’s API supports the authorization code grant type using the standard authorization code flow or the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension.
New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections.
These are all generated from our collection of OpenAPI definitions.
This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Xero.

notes: Xero docs are JavaScript-rendered; read via a browser. Docs nav lists a 'Remote MCP' guide, but that page returned 'Not Authorized' so it was not read. Starter tier daily limit is 1,000 calls per tenant. REST is inferred from OpenAPI/SDK wording.
